caseNameFull: PRICE Et Al. v. MOSS Et Al.
attorneys: Walt Allen, Jim A. Rinehart, Leon S. Hirsh and James C.Harkin for appellants in No. 688., Frank Carter for appellants in No. 689., Norman Reynolds, Jr. and Sid White for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeals are dismissed as the order of the District Court is not appeal-able under 28 U. S. C. § 1253.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Goldberg concur in the result. Mr. Justice Harlan would postpone consideration of the question of jurisdiction until after argument on the merits.
